building.boss4.deepest: Looks like you've reached the very end. There don't seem to be any Warp Panels or anything here.
building.boss4.yamijin: And here it is! The one and only Lord Yamijin!
building.boss4.talk: Yamijin: That's riiight. Glad you came.
{player}: You! Why did you kidnap that kid?!
Yamijin: Nya? What an idiot, nya. We met at that house just the other day.
{player}: (I get it! Yamijin kidnapped the kid, found out where the kid lives, and went there to steal the food!)
Yamijin: I've got no use for someone I'm done with, nya. They're probably suffering way in the back, nyee hee, kyeeheeheeheehee!
{player}: You! What do you think a person's life is?! Answer me right now, you scum!
Yamijin: Now, now, calm down, okay?
{player}: Huh? Calm down? If you think I can calm down, you're dead wrong. Think about what you're doing and sort out your head before you say that!
Yamijin: Oh, fiiine. Life is just a thing that exists, nya. Nobody can live without eating other lives, nya.
{player}: Yeah, asking you was a mistake. I'll smash you right here.
Yamijin: Oh well, can't be hewped, nya.
building.boss4.summon: Yamijin: Kyeeheeheeheehee! This one's a little different from last tiiime!
building.boss4.vanished: With that, Yamijin vanished. No matter how furious you are, the enemy right in front of you has to be beaten first. Wait, this time it's... this weirdly huge mecha?!
building.boss4.after: Yamijin, you jerk! Next time I see you, I'll squash you flat! Stupid, stupid!
Grumbling insults, {player} looked around. It seems a path further in has opened up. Either way, the kid is very likely somewhere in this mansion, so {player} decided to keep going.

Come on, hurry up and take me to the exit!
